lcc_original: 第七日上帝完畢了他所作的工，就在第七日歇了他所作的一切工而休息。
notes: LCC 上帝 vs UNV 神 — both = H430 (אֱלֹהִים); tag transfers without issue

H7673/WTH8799 (וַיִּשְׁבֹּת) placed on 歇了: UNV split the verb across 歇了…安息了<WH07673>, but in LCC 歇了 is the governing main verb; 而休息 is an appositional expansion with no independent Hebrew word and is left unannotated
Chinese relative particle 所 is the explicit reflex of אֲשֶׁר (WAH0834) in both clauses; UNV marked both as implicit {<WAH0834>} so braces are dropped and tag attaches directly to 所
UNV opens with 到 (untagged preposition) absent in LCC; the ב prefix WAH09002 attaches to 日 in both versions
Pronoun 他 (possessive suffix on מְלַאכְתּוֹ) left untagged in both clauses, following UNV convention
